summary: KEEP. Acceptance ① (no process resumes without durable before state): the prepare path journals the complete launch material — verbatim command, lease, before manifest + digest, scan policy, ephemeral roots — before anything can advance, refuses unparseable material before it becomes durable, and advancing an unjournaled operation is OperationNotFound. Acceptance ② (recovery never reruns the command): the frozen command_json is the only command source, byte-identical across replays and crash-reopens, served to recovery through the incomplete-process-effects query oldest-first; transitions are monotonic and idempotent so a restart reconciles rather than re-executes. Acceptance ③ (quarantine lasts through receipt): tree_quarantine_lift_eligible is false with no operation and until the terminal receipt, the receipt digest is pinned and irreplaceable, a receipted operation can never be downgraded to quarantined, and quarantined operations never gain a receipt — the coupling the sweep path will consume. Disclosed: this is the store layer only — no runtime wiring swaps the transport's in-memory supervisor journal for this repository yet (P23's disclosed follow-up, a later composition round); P26's delta scanner will read these rows. House 1086/1085/1 with only the declared plan_schema baseline; zero flake members across both full runs.
